data.title: Increment splash screen min visible time to 1s

epic.spec:
# Increment splash screen min visible time to 1s

## Overview
Raise the minimum splash screen display time from 500ms to 1000ms so users see the full entrance animation (500ms) plus a brief breathing glow (~500ms) before transitioning.

## Scope
- Change `minSplashDuration` constant from 500ms to 1000ms
- Update doc comments: remove "aligned with entrance animation" claim, add new rationale (entrance + breathing glow)
- Fix all test timing: tearDown resets, fakeAsync elapsed times, slow-failure bootstrap delay (must exceed 1000ms)
- Update spec and plan docs that hardcode "500ms" minimum splash references

## Out of scope
- Entrance animation duration stays at 500ms (`splash_screen.dart:45` comment, `screen-prompts/00-splash-screen.md:17` — leave untouched)
- `plan_app_launch_handoff.md:375` "fade + slide, 500ms" refers to entrance animation — leave untouched
- `testSplashDuration` (10ms override in tests) — stays at 10ms for fast non-timing tests

## Key decisions
- **Slow-failure test delay**: Change from 600ms to 1100ms (maintains ~100ms margin above splash)
- **fakeAsync intermediate checks**: Keep 200ms first checkpoint (still proves no early transition), adjust second elapse to reach 1000ms total
- **Doc comment rationale**: "Ensures the entrance animation (500ms) completes and the breathing glow is briefly visible before any state transition"

## Quick commands
```bash
flutter test test/startup/
flutter analyze
```

## Acceptance
- [ ] `StartupViewModel.minSplashDuration` equals `Duration(milliseconds: 1000)`
- [ ] Doc comments on lines 102-103 and 111 reflect 1000ms with updated rationale
- [ ] All tests in `test/startup/` pass with updated timing
- [ ] "Slow failure" test uses bootstrap delay > 1000ms (e.g. 1100ms)
- [ ] Spec doc (`docs/specs/20260322120000_spec_app_launch_handoff.md`) updated: splash-minimum 500ms references changed to 1000ms (entrance animation 500ms refs left alone)
- [ ] Plan doc (`plan_app_launch_handoff.md`) updated: splash-minimum 500ms references changed to 1000ms (entrance animation 500ms refs left alone)
- [ ] `flutter analyze` clean
- [ ] `flutter test test/startup/` passes

## References
- Constant: `lib/startup/startup_view_model.dart:105`
- Tests: `test/startup/startup_view_model_test.dart`, `test/startup/startup_view_test.dart`
- Spec: `docs/specs/20260322120000_spec_app_launch_handoff.md`
- Plan: `plan_app_launch_handoff.md`
- Related epic: fn-79 (established the 500ms value)

# fn-80-increment-splash-screen-min-visible.1 Bump minSplashDuration to 1000ms, fix tests and docs

## Description
Bump the splash screen minimum visible time from 500ms to 1000ms and update all references.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `lib/startup/startup_view_model.dart` — constant + doc comments
- `test/startup/startup_view_model_test.dart` — tearDown reset, 4 fakeAsync test timings, slow-failure delay
- `test/startup/startup_view_test.dart` — tearDown reset
- `docs/specs/20260322120000_spec_app_launch_handoff.md` — ~7 splash-minimum 500ms refs
- `plan_app_launch_handoff.md` — ~9 splash-minimum 500ms refs

## Approach

1. **Production code** (`startup_view_model.dart`):
   - Line 105: change `Duration(milliseconds: 500)` to `Duration(milliseconds: 1000)`
   - Lines 102-103: update doc comment — remove "aligned with entrance animation duration (500ms)", replace with "Ensures the entrance animation (500ms) completes and the breathing glow is briefly visible before any state transition"
   - Line 111: update parenthetical to reflect 1000ms

2. **Test files**:
   - `startup_view_model_test.dart:53` tearDown: change reset value from 500 to 1000
   - `startup_view_test.dart:43` tearDown: change reset value from 500 to 1000
   - Four fakeAsync tests (lines 180-289): update `minSplashDuration` override from 500 to 1000, adjust `elapse()` calls to reach 1000ms total (e.g., 200ms first check + 800ms second elapse)
   - Slow-failure bootstrap delay (`line 219`): change from 600ms to 1100ms
   - Adjust corresponding elapsed times in slow-failure test to match

3. **Docs** — find-and-replace splash-minimum "500ms" with "1000ms":
   - `docs/specs/20260322120000_spec_app_launch_handoff.md`: lines 10, 129, 133, 135, 156, 164-165
   - `plan_app_launch_handoff.md`: lines 139, 163, 227, 318, 344, 346, 365, 391
   - **Leave alone**: entrance animation refs (line 375 of plan, line 17 of screen prompt)

## Key context

- `testSplashDuration` (10ms at line 20) stays unchanged — only used for fast non-timing tests
- Entrance animation is 500ms (`splash_screen.dart:45`) — this does NOT change
- Pattern at `startup_view_model.dart:116`: `Future.wait([_bootstrap(), Future.delayed(minSplashDuration)])` — mechanism unchanged, only duration value changes
## Acceptance
- [ ] `StartupViewModel.minSplashDuration` equals `Duration(milliseconds: 1000)`
- [ ] Doc comment at lines 102-103 no longer claims "aligned with entrance animation"; states new rationale
- [ ] Doc comment at line 111 reflects 1000ms
- [ ] tearDown in `startup_view_model_test.dart` resets to 1000ms
- [ ] tearDown in `startup_view_test.dart` resets to 1000ms
- [ ] All 4 fakeAsync timing tests use 1000ms override and adjusted elapse calls
- [ ] Slow-failure bootstrap delay exceeds 1000ms (e.g. 1100ms)
- [ ] `flutter test test/startup/` passes
- [ ] Spec doc splash-minimum refs updated to 1000ms (entrance animation refs untouched)
- [ ] Plan doc splash-minimum refs updated to 1000ms (entrance animation refs untouched)
- [ ] `flutter analyze` clean
